spec_match.rationale: The expected surface list is transcribed from the PR 672 IDL and the Chromium CL 7879985 IDL diff, including the distinction that maxWriteWithoutResponseSize and its handler attribute belong to the flag-guarded sibling feature, not this one.

interactive.rationale: The walk (Object.getOwnPropertyNames up the real chain) runs on load and on a re-run button; summary counters, the diff table and the explanation all render from live measurement, including an unexpected-extras detector.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises a diff of every member against the Chrome 157 surface including the flag-guarded split; delivered exactly.

edge_cases.rationale: Interface-absent renders an explicit no-surface row instead of an empty pass; pre-157 shows the three methods as missing; extras row exposes polyfills/leaked members; flag-guarded members are labelled rather than counted as failures of this feature.

references.rationale: chromestatus entry, spec PR preview, the implementation CL (source of the IDL diff) and sibling concepts are linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite's existing-surface-unchanged and inherited-not-own assertions encode the same additive contract the table visualises.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141: interface-absent branch verified in DOM and screenshots (expected=11, found=n/a, caption '(interface absent)'), re-run clicked via same-origin driver, console clean, both viewport classes screenshotted.

telemetry_health.rationale: inventory-walked assert fires with exposed/foundCount/inheritedCount/extras detail on every walk including the absent branch.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; the diff table lives in an overflow-x scroller; the flag note uses the amber note treatment; summary cards reuse the house readout pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table with caption and column headers, dl summary counters, aria-live detail output, one native button; verdict colours meet AA on paper.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: scrollWidth 360 at a 360px viewport with the table scrolling internally; 500px and 1280px screenshots show no clipped controls and legible mono cells.

openQuestions.title: Verify the found/inherited/extras counts on a 157 build and behind the sibling flag
openQuestions.detail: Three states remain unverified for want of a newer build: plain 157 should read 9 of 11 found with 3 via EventTarget and the flag-guarded pair missing; 157 with --enable-blink-features=WebBluetoothMaxWriteWithoutResponseSize should read 11 of 11; and a page with a Web Bluetooth polyfill loaded should trip the unexpected-extras counter.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates with aria-live regions for async operations
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use real data tables with captions and scoped headers for tabular comparisons, and announce recomputed results through a live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The diff is a semantic table whose caption carries the found-count; the interpretation paragraph is an aria-live output updated on every walk.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls layout without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide tabular content should scroll inside its own overflow container; summary stats should reflow with auto-fit grids.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Table wrapped in overflow-x:auto with overflow-wrap on member cells; summary uses auto-fit minmax(150px,1fr); measured clean at 360px.

summary: Inspection tooling: a live prototype walk diffed against the spec surface, honest about the interface being absent in this build, explicit that the flag-guarded members are a different feature, and armed with an extras detector so a polyfill cannot masquerade as the real inheritance.
